_how: The ONE settings file of the GoHighLevel fragment builder (build-fragments.mjs). Everything that differs between staging and production is in 'profiles'. A value in CAPITALS (DATE) is a placeholder: the value is not known yet. check-fragments.mjs lists every placeholder still in use. mode, endpoint, reviewsEndpoint, allowedOrigins, googleAdsSendTo (production ONLY), firePixelEvents and the optional staging-only savedLinkBase become window.PPSite in the site body code (shared/CORE-API.md section 13.3); build-fragments.mjs refuses a profile whose send settings break the rules in lib.mjs settingsProblems(), and check-fragments.mjs hands the object in each block to the engine's own siteOptions(). 'pageDataInOwnFile' names the pages whose page data ALWAYS goes in a file of its own (pages/<slug>.schema.html) in EVERY profile, whatever the block's length; for every other page the length rule (blockLimit) decides. It is a shared setting on purpose: which blocks a page has must not depend on how many staging page ids this file holds (rollout/saturday/faq-split.md). Explained line by line in rollout/FRAGMENT-NOTES.md.
_repository: The staging profile holds .invalid placeholders: the real staging addresses and page ids are kept outside this public repository. Only the production profile is built and checked here.
